glyph_origin: Originally 𦔻, hence ideogrammic compound (會意): 耳 (“ear”) + 口 (“mouth(s)”) – to listen. Compare the top component of 聖. Later, rewritten as phono-semantic compound (形聲): phonetic 𡈼 + semantic 耳 (“ear”) + semantic 㥁 on the right. The simplified version, 𠯸 (later stylized as 听), is totally unrelated to the original character and it originally means "smiling".
s_page_origin: From 𠯸 (phonetic 厅). / Phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 口 (“mouth”) + phonetic 斤.
senses: [tīng] to listen; to hear; to listen to (radio, etc.)
(obsolete in standard Chinese) to handle (matters of state); to administer
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 聽; s_page_origin explains the simplified 听.
